name: AI for Research Workflows
outcome: Apply AI to a research workflow and verify the resulting outputs.
description: Use AI to support a small research workflow, such as literature exploration, scientific writing or data interpretation. Verify claims and outputs against reliable evidence and document AI assistance.
external: Basic digital literacy and familiarity with the chosen research activity.
prior: Familiarity with the chosen research activity
learn: Apply AI to a bounded research task
Document inputs, limitations and AI assistance
moduleDescriptions: Select a bounded literature, writing or analysis task with clear success criteria.
Use an approved assistant to complete one step while retaining human control.
Verify claims and citations against primary sources or reference data.
Record prompts, sources, model settings and disclosure of AI assistance.
prerequisiteRationale: F02 establishes prompting, source checking and safe AI use before applying these to research tasks.
